title:
Tracking, review
and customising
say: Part three covers tracking cells over time, reviewing and changing your answers, and making the app your own.

title: It jumps? Tap where it goes
say: This deck asks whether a tracker stays on the same cell. If it jumps to a neighbour, choose It jumps. Then go to that frame and tap where the cell really is. The app also records which segmented cell you tapped.

title: Divisions: tap both daughters
say: When a cell divides, choose Divides and tap both daughter cells. Each tap is saved with its position, its frame and its cell number.

title: Track a cell yourself
say: In a follow deck you track a cell yourself. Tap the cell in each frame and the app moves on by itself. Hold the image to see the previous frame. Not here skips a frame. When the cell divides, tap Divides and then both daughters.

title: Review and change answers
say: Review shows every card with your answer. Filter by answer, tap any card and answer it again. The full history is kept, so nothing is ever lost.

title: Add a note
say: Tap note to leave a comment on any card. Notes go into the export together with your answers.

title: Make the answers your own
say: You can edit the answer buttons to rename them or add new ones. You can also choose what happens next, like drawing a mask or typing a number. And you can switch on confetti for the answer you're hoping to see.

title: Colours, name and backup
say: In settings you can set your name, switch to colours that are safe for colour blindness, and turn on live save or back up everything. Restore a backup on any device, or share a Google Drive folder with your team and compare everyone's answers in results.

title: deke1yahav.github.io/hooman
say: That's Hooman in the Loop. It's free and open source. The AI guesses. The hooman decides.
